proposals.evidence: The complete cached Platts article gives ḵẖarāb “spoiled, bad” and its Arabic origin; Liljegren LX002408 explicitly identifies Urdu xaraab as the donor of Palula xaraap. The existing Hindi/Urdu xaraab node therefore provides an attested regional donor for Pothwari xarāv with b/v adaptation. The borrowed link is a provisional regional transmission hypothesis, not a claim of direct Arabic contact.
